description: This file defines a controller class for managing 'Information' tasks within the OpenCart admin module. It includes methods to generate task lists, retrieve information data, create JSON files for information entries, and clear cached files. The class interacts with models to fetch data and appears to facilitate task management and data serialization for the admin interface.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Controller class for managing 'Information' related tasks in admin, including generating task lists, exporting data to JSON, and clearing cached files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of tasks related to Information, including clearing old data, listing current information entries, and scheduling info tasks.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a JSON file containing a list of information entries, including associated descriptions, and responds with success or error message.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Creates a JSON file for a specific information entry identified by 'information_id' and returns success or error message.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes the cached JSON information file.
